<subject>Damage to Port Equipment – M/V Tasman Venture – Recovery Action</subject>
<body>
Waiting on response from your people about:
Meeting with claims adjuster regarding recovery action against equipment supplier.
Engaging independent engineering consultant to challenge insurer's surveyor's assessment.

Have written letter to vessel owner requesting extension of time for filing claim (this protects the subrogation interests of the insurer).

Seeking clarification on policy requirement for filing formal claim against insurer within twelve months of loss. Broker advises this may not be necessary as the incident was reported and claim remains under review, but will obtain written confirmation from insurer/adjuster.

Michael Boyer to contact Perth attorney representing the equipment supplier's insurer about coordinating their claim against the vessel owner.

If anyone above has anything else to add, or corrections to what I have listed, please add at this time so we are all aligned.
</body>
<quoted>
</quoted>
